headline_marked: Police [[recover bomb-like device]] near Lalon Shah shrine in Kushtia
headline: Police recover bomb-like device near Lalon Shah shrine in Kushtia
summary: A suspicious device featuring petrol bottles, iron pipes, and electric wiring was found near the entrance of the Baul saint's shrine.
details: Police recovered a suspicious device consisting of petrol-filled bottles, iron pipes, and electric wires from the entrance of the Baul saint Lalon Shah's shrine in Kushtia's Kumarkhali.
The device was discovered around 1 am on Monday near a coconut tree on the right side of the entrance.
Upon receiving reports of a suspicious bag, police officers immediately moved devotees away from the area to ensure their safety.
A four-member bomb disposal and explosives expert team from the Counter Terrorism and Transnational Crime (CTTC) unit of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police was deployed to the scene.
The expert team, led by Police Inspector Modassher Kaiser, recovered two one-litre bottles of petrol, two iron pipes, and a device fitted with electric wiring.
A senior officer of the bomb disposal unit stated that it is not yet certain what kind of device was recovered or how powerful it is.
caption:
A suspicious bomb-like device was found at the entrance of Baul saint Lalon Shah's shrine in Kushtia.

Police recovered a suspicious device consisting of petrol-filled bottles, iron pipes, and electric wires from the entrance of the Baul saint Lalon Shah's shrine in Kushtia's Kumarkhali.

The device was discovered around 1 am on Monday near a coconut tree on the right side of the entrance.

Upon receiving reports of a suspicious bag, police officers immediately moved devotees away from the area to ensure their safety.

A four-member bomb disposal and explosives expert team from the Counter Terrorism and Transnational Crime (CTTC) unit of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police was deployed to the scene.

The expert team, led by Police Inspector Modassher Kaiser, recovered two one-litre bottles of petrol, two iron pipes, and a device fitted with electric wiring.

A senior officer of the bomb disposal unit stated that it is not yet certain what kind of device was recovered or how powerful it is.
